title: The ledger projection stays truthful when node status is edited directly
notes: GREEN: consumers on the contracted path read the projection; the recorded terminal failed absorbs the un-recorded direct edit to passed. RED: the only truth source is the lying node dict. (Lane 5 owns the dashboard endpoint that reads this projection.) gate_replay mode: the driver exercises the REAL scheduler/dispatcher/ledger seams inside the sandbox HARNESS_DIR. GREEN env sets SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=1 (the Lane 3 fix); RED injects SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=0 (the pre-contract world) and the same expect must fail — proving the scenario discriminates the class, not the plumbing.
